purpose: Re-verify applicability of booster16 reusable patches on this machine before the native 1.7 bridge work. Fresh copies; GIT_CEILING_DIRECTORIES set to the scratch root so git cannot see the parent repositories.

results.result: FAIL on RoboCupCtrl.cpp hunk at clean-2e3374 line ~347: bhuman-local inserts a profile-timing block between gameController.update() and the robot update loop, which breaks the patch context. GameController.h/.cpp hunks check clean.
results.note: This is a context conflict with the local audit-hook changes, not a patch defect.

consequence_for_bridge: Variants built from bhuman-local can apply both SimRobot patches as-is. The referee-frame patch is not needed for the minimal native 1.7 replacement layer; if it is later required in a bhuman-local-based variant, it must be re-based onto the audit-hook context as a clearly labeled bridge-side adaptation (the public patch stays untouched).
